in_sanskrit.name: Dipun
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Luminous, Radiant
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dipun एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'dipana' meaning 'luminous, radiant', Dipun is a name that signifies brightness and illumination. This name is believed to bring light and positivity into one's life.
